title: Artel runtime interface v1
description: Artel runtime v1 executable contract, DEV-A01-A04-001 spec4. Exact hash handshake; strict selective app/branch projections and bounded recovery. No lifecycle ownership in transport.

rules.principal: Server binding only; payload principal is forbidden.
rules.dedup: Canonical recursively key-sorted JSON of the entire command, UTF-8 SHA-256. Resolve existing receipt before target/revision admission. No new commandId for retry.
rules.receiptRetention: At least dedupHorizonMs after terminal; retaining existing receipts indefinitely is valid. Unresolved command/effect never expires. Missing record alone is outcome_unknown.
rules.queueRevision: queue is per-item revision for item operations, aggregate queue revision for reorder; expectedOrder additionally validates reorder. Enqueue does not change intent revision.
rules.historyRevision: history is the expected leaf entry ID; history edits preserve canonical source role.
rules.branch: history-branch-and-run returns its distinct canonical AGI and origin; no identity is inferred from a UI node ID.
rules.send: Busy Send enqueues; held/stopped/interrupted enqueue does not release holds. Resume/continue/queue-release are explicit.
rules.crash: Restore queues/history/receipts/holds, interrupt prior running attempts, no automatic effectful replay or queue drain.
rules.updates: Strict summary/detail variants. All changes have owner identity/revision and inclusive throughCursor; filter before expensive materialization. No empty app batch per token; bounded reconciliation heartbeat only. WS update including JSON-RPC envelope and owner eventBatch must each fit64KiB; all changes are nondecreasing cursor<=throughCursor<=headCursor (head on owner batches). One owner-cursor projection group cannot be split across ACK cuts; producer uses a bounded descriptor/invalidation if the full group cannot fit.
rules.writer: One command dispatcher per observer independent of channels. AgentSummary has one reducer: app summary events and guarded HTTP catalog only. Detail snapshots/receipts/text never write live summary.
rules.http: Auth/settings/profile/catalog/history/search/files remain HTTP. Mutating execution goes through runtime.command.
rules.channels: One app plus observed-root-family channels; server principal/session generation + observerId + channel identity. Reconnect replaces only that composite key. Multiple panels share their family channel; last detail unsubscribe releases buffers/socket, never cancels execution.
rules.interests: catalog is summary only. branch membership includes every current/future descendant from Engine ancestry; interests are explicit selected AGI/types. kind=agent follows current Attempt; kind=attempt pins exact Attempt. A newly discovered child never opts into thinking. Standalone agent/attempt scopes are HTTP/internal reads; WS details use branch scope. Engine validates every selected AGI against durable family membership before materialization. A branch command target must be an authorized member of that channel root; app uses the same handler without changing the frozen command payload.
rules.summary: Full AgentSummary upsert; null clears optional state. Revision is monotonically increasing per AGI within epoch on every summary change, not just intent. No summary change/upsert for a token alone. State/target/outcome never inferred by BFF or UI; worktree binding comes from authoritative metadata, never ancestry. The no-Attempt native state is registered. outcome uses native completed/cancelled/failed/interrupted; UI labels may map this without altering runtime facts. Exact runtime.summary reads one authorized indexed AGI summary and returns summaryRead with consistent epoch/generation/watermark/work, without scanning catalog or detail. Guarded HTTP /summary joins the same sole summary reducer as catalog.
rules.ordering: No app/branch arrival order. Terminal summary never stops detail; settled+history boundary completes it. Every detail identifies exact Attempt. PendingStart target supersedes older terminal Attempt only when authoritatively reported; result.target is command context, never a summary writer. Every actionTarget carries its own authorityGeneration; pendingStart requires exact paired attemptId/executionId. Summary owner generation does not substitute pending target generation. detailState.target identifies exactly detailState.attemptId (null means no Attempt); it is action context for that detail, never substituted with pendingStart of another Attempt. Input/usage/context/history invalidations always carry exact attemptId; queue/holds invalidations are AGI-scoped.
rules.recovery: fresh rejects old cursors. snapshot continues after the supplied fresh owner cut; reconnect may replay only compatible epoch/projectionHash. projectionHash is SHA256 of canonicalRuntimeJson(scope), and all source copies use this contract hash. HTTP request/response is guarded by local observer interest/auth generation; stale restore is aborted. Total replay budgets span every hasMore, never reset per batch; excessive gap must be detected by bounded indexed work, then resnapshot. Owner eventBatch reports bounded work and headCursor from that consistent read. Recovery freezes its end at the first headCursor and must not chase a moving live head. Total work counters continue across hasMore. Query-side resync errors stop before materializing an unbounded backlog. Native runtime.events.wait receives fixed untilCursor after the first owner head plus remainingWork. Owner limits indexed scanning/decoding before materialization to that cut and remaining budgets; zero remaining fails with restore_budget. These counters are decremented for every response, not discarded only at BFF. Live queries also have finite per-call bounds. untilCursor implies no wait beyond that fixed cut. response.work.elapsedMs and remainingWork.timeMs count actual owner query/projection work, excluding idle wake wait. Recovery separately enforces total wall-clock replayTimeoutMs and does not wait beyond its fixed cut. Normal live eventWaitMs25s is not itself a restore-budget failure.
rules.bootstrap: One bounded current snapshot and one HTTP history page by default; no all-page drain. bootstrapRecords is total emitted records (each page still max100); bootstrapScannedRows counts examined backend rows, materialized bytes counts all owner data decoded including omitted output. Snapshot and owner cut consistent; finite live buffer. Initial detail exposes bounded active metadata and versioned HTTP resources when full state does not fit, never an oversize reset loop. snapshot.work, historyPage.work and eventBatch.work are actual per-response counters, not cumulative; operation owner sums each once, including scanned/decoded data discarded by filtering. No counter reset on page/hasMore.
rules.budgets: All byte limits are encoded UTF-8 JSON including envelopes. Observer unacked8MiB/relay16MiB INCLUDE app reserve1MiB/2MiB; branches may use at most7MiB/14MiB. Server32MiB/64MiB includes four observer quotas; maxObservers4 prevents a fifth consuming their reserves. Per-channel1MiB/2MiB also applies. Control delivery is additional but capped per-channel256KiB, observer1MiB, server4MiB. RPC32+8 is total per observer, server128+32; branches leave app4+2. Count pending/inflight maps even on reconnect until work settles. HTTP2 per observer/8 server. ACK has a separate bounded rate so output cannot consume command reserve. Uninitialized sockets/pending upgrades bounded separately; app/replacement must be admitted without an extra permanent channel slot. maxConnections144 bounds physical accepted+pending-upgrade sockets; at most128 initialized and16 uninitialized, pending upgrades count toward these total bounds. Per observer32 includes one reserved app slot, at most31 branch channels; replacement uses temporary uninitialized capacity and atomically replaces only its prior logical channel. An observer remains counted while its old in-flight work is unsettled.
rules.restoreBudgets: Replay: total2MiB/4096changes/8192scannedRows/4MiBmaterialized/2s, first exceeded limit stops replay; actual scanned/materialized work must be measured at owner, not inferred from response size. Bootstrap:2MiB/200records/500scannedRows/4MiBmaterialized/5s. Snapshot-live buffer1MiB/1024changes. Cache16MiB/8scopes plus detail window1MiB/200records; renderer100records/64KiB text window. Evict only reconstructable detail, never unresolved command journal. Up to3 automatic resets/30s then explicit stale/recovery state until user retry or backoff window; exponential jitter backoff250ms..30s.
rules.bulk: Files/history/complete large results use existing owner HTTP resources, not arbitrary URLs or a new store. Known bulk is not split into WS fragments; true selected live text may continue as bounded deltas. Descriptor pins identity/version/bytes/mediaType; partial preview is explicit. HTTP ranges<=64KiB and pages<=1MiB; no eager full parsing/render. Input details preserve existing controls. Oversized raw input/args/diff stays in existing owner event and is exposed by inputResource + explicit partial preview; /resource is one bounded adapter for existing history/message/input owner reads, no store or router framework. inputMaxQuestions/options guard is checked before pending input creation, with explicit tool validation error so the agent can reformulate; never drop IDs/options. inputPreviewBytes bounds the whole preview, partial=true requires the exact full owner resource. No silent label/text truncation; full raw content remains lazily available.
rules.textRanges: All offsets are UTF-8 bytes at codepoint boundaries; encoded text bytes=endOffset-offset. Identity is AGI+Attempt+messageId+blockId+stream+contentId. contentId identifies an append-only lineage; it changes on rewrite/truncate/history edit. snapshot is a bounded baseline (partial indicates missing ranges); append requires exact baseRevision, offset equal to previous totalBytes, increasing revision and same contentId. Revision does not reuse a different prefix. A matching older HTTP range may fill only proven immutable-prefix holes of the same contentId up to descriptor.bytes; never overwrite later ranges or append to an incomplete preview as full text. Other bases are discarded/refetched. Resource serves the exact frozen history revision or the guaranteed immutable prefix of message lineage; unprovable/missing version returns stale/resource-not-found, not mutable latest.
rules.observation: No per-closed-observer backlog or background detail hydration. Canonical history/events/receipts/effects continue without interest. Observer filtering never suppresses required durable facts. Reopen uses fresh state and history access; UI never replays tool effects.
rules.nativeTarget: Trusted existing IPC only, no browser endpoint/principal fields in browser commands. Resolve actual stored native target from exact fullAGI+optional Attempt/execution. Explicit IDs must match exactly; pending->bound sameIDs permitted, otherwise stale_target. Without IDs current canonical bound is preferred, pending is queried by exactIDs. Never infer bindingId/bindingGeneration/targetEngineGeneration from browser summary or currentEngineGeneration. registered contains no Attempt/binding. authorizedAgentInstanceRefs is an optional bounded restriction, never truncated into a device AGI cap. Optional rootAgentInstanceRef is trusted routing context, outside the frozen command/hash; Engine verifies principal, exact target and root ancestry in the same authoritative read. An unregistered explicit root launch may only enroll root==target through the existing admission path; unknown descendants require authoritative enrollment before effects. pending may expose factual source Start startExpectedIntentRevision alongside its commandId; bound exposes paired startCommandId/startExpectedIntentRevision, both or neither. Legacy missing source CAS is omitted, never inferred from current intent or base+1. Pre-start Stop validates the immutable source Start and its actually applied intent revision, with no intervening intent change; ordinary Stop CAS is unchanged.
rules.inputs: Exact /input uses AGI+Attempt+inputId+immutable input revision. No-ID inputPage.revision is persisted per-Attempt collection mutation revision (requested/resolved/denied/cancelled/terminal clear), not token cursor. holdsPage.revision is AGI intentRevision, advanced on every effective hold mutation including ancestor/recovery/enrollment; exact old Attempt reads become stale_target after current Attempt changes. messagesPage uses per-Attempt collection revision; every contained message retains its own lineage/revision. All pages/work are bounded and read lazily. New UI submit uses indexedQuestionAnswer (question id + unique selectedOptionIndexes + optional free text/note), not echoed question/option labels. Engine resolveInput validates exact inputId/revision/intent, all question IDs, index bounds against that stored question and multi cardinality; then reconstructs the full existing native tool result from canonical input. CH forwards compact frozen bytes and never expands them into a second oversized IPC payload. Legacy echoed answers remain a separate strict compatibility variant and require the same owner validation. AGI holds reads may omit Attempt; holdsPage.attemptId is null before any Attempt. If an Attempt is supplied, it is checked exactly.
rules.queueReads: Queue pages are AGI-scoped, independent of Attempt, and identify the aggregate queueRevision; exact queueId uses the same page with zero or one item. Project only public queueItem fields, never sourceBody or native/session identity. Every item is <=liveChangeBytes, every page <=httpPageBytes and <=httpPageRecords. Read owner metadata/sizes before large fields; report actual work including decoded omitted data. Oversized deliveryPayload, annotation or sender is an explicit immutable-prefix preview with a pinned queue_item resource for that exact field/AGI/queueId/item revision. deliveryPayload partial requires resource; ancillary previews carry annotationResource/senderResource. If any field is partial, JSON-encoded deliveryPayload/annotation/sender previews together are <=bulkPreviewBytes. Full text remains in existing owner columns; UTF8 ranges are <=httpRangeBytes with exact revision checks and no whole-item materialization per range. Queue command receipt result.item uses the same bounded public projection. Never save a preview as the full editable text: explicit edit loads the pinned body first and cancels on changed selection/revision.
rules.historyLifecycle: One initial history HTTP page contains bounded native entries and public lifecycle activities, sharing limit<=100 and all byte/work budgets. work.changes counts entries+activities. Activities preserve exact AGI/session/Attempt/execution/event identity; id is engine:sessionId:agentInstanceRef:attemptId:eventId. Optional beforeEntryId/afterEntryId are mutually exclusive and name a retained public user/assistant entry in this pinned native page; otherwise activity is unanchored. Only meaningful native events for Attempts reachable by sourceCommandId/assistantMessageId in this page, plus its exact current Attempt cut, are included. No jobs/full-history scan or BFF lifecycle inference. Initial page divides available records between entries and activities (limit1 may return one entry with explicit activity continuation); unused capacity may be reused. activityNextCursor is separate from older-entry nextCursor; explicit activityCursor expansion on the same /history returns entries=[] and nextCursor=null. Both opaque cursors pin authorized AGI, session, immutable lineage, native leaf/page range and event watermark/before-ID; append does not move the cut, rewrite/branch-edit invalidates old lineage with stale_target. Continuations never auto-drain. Existing canonical history/outbox metadata and indexed bounded reads are the owners; query work includes all scanned/decoded rows, not only emitted records. Lifecycle error/retry previews stay bounded; details use retained owner resources where applicable.
rules.tools: Fresh detailState includes at most16 active or uncertain tool snapshots (native states started or unknown) at the same authoritative cut; toolsNextCursor is null only when complete. Planned approvals remain pendingInputs; known settled outcomes remain native history and live terminal toolChange. Each toolSnapshot has its native effect revision; phase unknown and denied preserve native meaning and are never rewritten as failed/cancelled. Explicit toolsPage continuation uses existing per-observer HTTP, page, record and whole-operation budgets, never background draining. Cursor pins exact AGI, Attempt and the per-Attempt tool lifecycle collection revision plus keyset position; lifecycle mutation yields stale_target and permits an explicit fresh read, while assistant tokens do not invalidate this cursor. Page revision is that lifecycle collection revision; each item has its own native effect revision. UI merges by exact Attempt/toolCallId/revision, ignores stale principal/epoch/channel responses, and never replaces newer live state with an older baseline/page. Existing detailStateBytes and snapshot budgets include tools and cursor; a byte-limited slice may contain fewer than16 tools. Tool result bodies remain existing immutable bounded HTTP resources.

/api/runtime/input.query: inputReadRequest or detailPageRequest when inputId absent

/api/runtime/resource.query: resourceReadRequest; resource JSON encoded as one query value

/api/runtime/history-entry.query: Existing legacy bounded history-entry range adapter; same owner handler
/api/runtime/history-entry.response: Existing compatibility DTO; new browser uses resource/httpRange

/api/runtime/history.query: historyReadRequest; cursor and activityCursor are mutually exclusive

toolCallId.description: Exact provider correlation ID: a legacy ID or two nonempty IDs joined by one pipe. The final negative lookahead requires absolute end of input, including for trailing newlines.
